verdict.rationale: Probes confirm a live llms.txt at docs.stripe.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with agent-directed guidance, and Stripe Tax docs are served as clean Markdown (tax.md returns 200). Many Tax doc pages are cited via .md URLs, so the agent-oriented docs reach the Tax subtree, not just the top level. Missing for 10: no evidence that llms.txt specifically indexes or guides agents through the Stripe Tax pages, as it appears to be Stripe-wide.
